info.name: Document Signing Platform
info.description:
Full API collection for the Document Signing Platform.

## Authentication
- **Auth endpoints** – no auth required
- **User / Envelope endpoints** – require `Authorization: Bearer <jwt>` (obtain from `/api/auth/login`)
- **Merchant / Envelope endpoints** – require `X-Api-Key: <merchant-api-key>` (returned when merchant is created)
- **Portal endpoints** – token is embedded in the URL path

## Variables
Set these collection variables before running:
| Variable | Description |
|---|---|
| `baseUrl` | e.g. `http://localhost:5163` |
| `jwtToken` | Bearer JWT from login |
| `merchantApiKey` | API key from create-merchant |
| `merchantId` | GUID from create-merchant |
| `envelopeId` | GUID from create-envelope |
| `signingToken` | Token from signing invitation email |
| `userId` | GUID from login JWT `sub` claim |

item.name: Auth
item.description: Registration, login, email verification, password reset. No API key or JWT required.

request.description:
Creates a new user account and sends a verification email.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | ✅ | Full display name |
| `email` | string | ✅ | Must be unique |
| `password` | string | ✅ | Min 8 chars, upper + lower + digit |
| `country` | string | ❌ | ISO country code |
| `accessRole` | string | ❌ | `"User"` (default) or `"Admin"` |

item.name: Merchants
item.description: Manage merchant accounts. A default merchant is auto-created on registration (if the user has none). Users can create additional merchant accounts via POST /api/merchants.

request.description:
Creates a new merchant account for a user. Users can create multiple merchant accounts. Returns 201 with the new merchant (including `id` and `apiKey`). The test script saves `merchantId` and `merchantApiKey` to collection variables.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `userId` | UUID | ✅ | Owner's user GUID (from login JWT `sub` claim) |
| `name` | string | ✅ | Merchant display name |
| `description` | string | ❌ | Optional description |
| `requestLimit` | int | ❌ | 0 = unlimited; default 100; must be >= 0 |
Returns a list of all merchants (admin use).

exec: console.log('merchantId and merchantApiKey saved from first result');

request.description:
Returns all merchant accounts belonging to a user. The test script auto-saves the first result's `id` and `apiKey` to collection variables.

| Param | Location | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `userId` | URL path | ✅ | User GUID from login JWT `sub` claim |

Returns a single merchant by GUID.

| Param | Location | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | URL path | ✅ | Merchant GUID |

Updates merchant settings.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | ❌ | Keeps current if omitted |
| `description` | string | ❌ | Keeps current if omitted |
| `isActive` | bool | ✅ | `true` to enable, `false` to suspend |
| `requestLimit` | int | ✅ | 0 = unlimited; must be >= 0 |
| `subscriptionEnd` | datetime | ❌ | ISO-8601 UTC; null = no expiry |

Issues a new API key for the merchant. The old key is invalidated immediately.

| Param | Location | Required | Notes |

| `id` | URL path | ✅ | Merchant GUID |

item.name: Envelopes
item.description: Multi-signer signing envelopes. All requests require `X-Api-Key` (merchant API key).

request.description:
Initiates a signing envelope. Sends email invitations to all signers.

**Header**
| Header | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `X-Api-Key` | ✅ | Merchant API key |

**Body – top-level**
| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | string | ✅ | Envelope display name |
| `merchantId` | UUID | ✅ | Must match the API key owner |
| `documents` | array | ✅ | At least one document |
| `signers` | array | ✅ | At least one signer |

**Body – each `documents[]` item**
| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `documentTitle` | string | ✅ | Human-readable title |
| `documentFileName` | string | ✅ | Filename with extension (e.g. `contract.pdf`) |
| `documentBase64` | string | ✅ | Base64-encoded file bytes |
| `documentContentType` | string | ❌ | `application/pdf`, `application/msword`, or `application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document`. If omitted, inferred from file extension. |

**Body – each `signers[]` item**
| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | ✅ | Signer full name |
| `email` | string | ✅ | Invitation sent here |
| `role` | string | ✅ | Free text, e.g. `"Signer"`, `"Counter-Signer"` |
| `order` | int | ✅ | Signing order (1-based) |
| `message` | string | ✅ | Personal note in the invitation email |
Returns all envelopes for the authenticated merchant.

Returns envelope metadata and signer statuses.

| Param | Location | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | URL path | ✅ | Envelope GUID |

Returns each signer's signed document as base64. `signedDocumentBase64` is `null` if not yet signed.

| Param | Location | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | URL path | ✅ | Envelope GUID |

item.name: Portal (Signing Flow)
item.description: Public endpoints used by the signer portal page. Token is embedded in the URL path — obtained from the signing email link.

variable.description: REQUIRED – signing token from email link

request.description:
Validates the signing token and returns document metadata + base64 content for preview.

| Param | Location | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `token` | URL path | ✅ | HMAC-signed signing token |

**Response fields**
| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `documentBase64` | string | Base64-encoded document bytes |
| `contentType` | string | MIME type |
| `claimantName` | string | Name of the intended signer |
| `documentFileName` | string | Original file name |
| `expiresAt` | datetime | Token expiry (UTC) |

variable.description: REQUIRED – signing token from email link

request.description:
Streams the raw document bytes with the correct MIME type (for iframe/embed preview).

| Param | Location | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `token` | URL path | ✅ | HMAC-signed signing token |

variable.description: REQUIRED – signing token from email link

request.description:
Submits the claimant's drawn or typed signature. Enqueues a background job to stamp the document.

| Param | Location | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `token` | URL path | ✅ | HMAC-signed signing token |

**Body**
| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `signatureBase64` | string | ✅ | Base64-encoded PNG signature image (data-URL prefix NOT included — raw base64 only) |

item.name: Users
item.description: User profile management. Requires `Authorization: Bearer <jwt>`. Admin-only endpoints noted.

request.description: Returns all registered users. Requires `Admin` role.

header.description: REQUIRED – own user or Admin JWT

request.description:
Returns a user by GUID. Admins may look up any user; regular users may only look up themselves.

| Param | Location | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | URL path | ✅ | User GUID |

header.description: REQUIRED – own user or Admin JWT

request.description:
Updates a user profile. Regular users may only change their own `name`. Only Admins may change `accessRole`.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | ❌ | New display name; ignored if blank |
| `accessRole` | string | ❌ | `"User"` or `"Admin"`. Non-admins receive 403 if set. |
